findings.message: CircleIcon now draws a horizontal line instead of a ring whenever there is no fill color, which changes every stroke-only circle legend in the app, not just the new case. Both built-in circle legends set only `color` and no fill: DEFAULT_USER_LAYER_LEGEND (src/features/create_layer/constants.ts:39, a point layer with a marker icon) and registerNewGeometryLayer.ts:34 (`style: { color: mainColor }`). For both, fillColor resolves to 'none', so the legend shows a line where it used to show a circle outline. Any backend-configured `stepShape: 'circle'` step with only `circle-stroke-color` gets the same wrong line icon.
